case.title: Bundle the fastener kit with one distributor
case.briefing: You negotiate for Hollerau Pumpenwerke with Schraubenhandel Leitner & Sohn GmbH. Bundle the fastener kit with one distributor. Need: 30000 kits a year. Category goal: routine: fewer suppliers and less process cost. Score: the lowest total cost C as defined in the rules, valued with this case's rates (need lead time 5 days). Fallback if you walk away: today's terms continue unchanged. Must-haves: none. Prepare from the data package.

messages.from_name: Inside Sales, Schraubenhandel Leitner & Sohn GmbH
messages.subject: Quote from Schraubenhandel Leitner & Sohn GmbH: Bundle the fastener kit with one distributor
messages.body:
Dear customer,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We are delighted to submit our offer for your consideration. We can offer you a price of €5.74 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel 30 days net, and a contract term of 12 months.

As a valued partner, we always strive to support your operations with our extensive inventory and reliable delivery service. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

We look forward to continuing our successful business relationship and standing by as your trusted partner for all your supply needs.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Stadler
Inside Sales, Schraubenhandel Leitner & Sohn GmbH

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Schraubenhandel Leitner & Sohn GmbH: Bundle the fastener kit with one distributor
messages.body:
Dear Mr. Stadler,

Thank you for your offer and for the many years of reliable cooperation between our two family companies. We value it greatly.

For bundling the fastener kit with you, our data shows the following:

German producer prices for fasteners changed +1.7% from 2025-08 to 2026-08 (idx:PPI-C2594@2025-08, idx:PPI-C2594@2026-08).

Our orders of Hex bolt ISO 4017 M12x40 8.8, zinc with you were placed at EUR 12.46 per 100 units on 2024-09-30 (po:4500011486-10), EUR 12.46 per 100 units on 2025-05-26 (po:4500012506-10), EUR 12.46 per 100 units on 2026-01-26 (po:4500013479-10) and EUR 12.46 per 100 units on 2026-09-30 (po:4500014475-10): the price has been unchanged.

Based on this, we would like to find a fair solution for both sides. Each option below gives you a longer contract term, and Option A and Option B also offer you more time on payment terms or a stronger price position in return:

We can offer you the following options:
Option A: unit price EUR 5.15; payment 60 days net; contract term 24 months.
Option B: unit price EUR 5.00; payment 45 days net; contract term 24 months.
Option C: unit price EUR 5.12; payment 30 days net; contract term 24 months.

We hope one of these suits you and look forward to your reply.

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

messages.from_name: Inside Sales, Schraubenhandel Leitner & Sohn GmbH
messages.subject: Re: Quote from Schraubenhandel Leitner & Sohn GmbH: Bundle the fastener kit with one distributor
messages.body:
Dear customer,

We have received a lot of material; we looked at what bears on this part. Your figures confirm our case: that driver rose. While we note the stable price history you cited for the hex bolts, please understand that those dynamics do not fully apply to this specific fastener kit. Our price follows our main cost drivers: PPI-C2594, LCI-C. 

We greatly value our long-standing cooperation and are pleased to support your request for a 24-month contract term. We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. Building on your Option C, we can offer a revised unit price of EUR 5.53 for a 24-month contract with 30 days net payment terms. 

For our complete Angebot, we propose a price of €5.53 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 24 months. Our general terms and conditions apply; the quote lists our standard terms. Please note that this offer stays valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Stadler
Inside Sales, Schraubenhandel Leitner & Sohn GmbH

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Schraubenhandel Leitner & Sohn GmbH: Bundle the fastener kit with one distributor
messages.body:
Dear Mr. Stadler,

Thank you for your reply and for the revised offer.

We understand that your price follows your cost drivers. Two further items in the kit show a different picture:

Our orders of Hex nut ISO 4032 M12 8, zinc with you were placed at EUR 4.91 per 100 units on 2024-09-30 (po:4500011486-20), EUR 4.91 per 100 units on 2025-06-02 (po:4500012538-10), EUR 4.91 per 100 units on 2026-01-30 (po:4500013504-10) and EUR 4.91 per 100 units on 2026-09-28 (po:4500014466-10): the price has been unchanged.

Our orders of Washer ISO 7089 M12, zinc with you were placed at EUR 12.78 per 1,000 units on 2024-10-10 (po:4500011536-10), EUR 12.78 per 1,000 units on 2025-06-11 (po:4500012581-10), EUR 12.78 per 1,000 units on 2026-01-29 (po:4500013501-10) and EUR 12.78 per 1,000 units on 2026-09-28 (po:4500014466-20): the price has been unchanged.

In the spirit of a fair solution for both of us, we have prepared these options. Each one runs for the longer term you welcomed, and the options with longer payment terms are meant to offer you a different balance between price and payment:

We can offer you the following options:
Option A: unit price EUR 5.20; payment 60 days net; contract term 24 months.
Option B: unit price EUR 5.05; payment 45 days net; contract term 24 months.
Option C: unit price EUR 5.17; payment 30 days net; contract term 24 months.

We hope one of them works for you and look forward to your response.

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

messages.from_name: Inside Sales, Schraubenhandel Leitner & Sohn GmbH
messages.subject: Re: Quote from Schraubenhandel Leitner & Sohn GmbH: Bundle the fastener kit with one distributor
messages.body:
Dear customer,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We appreciate your revised offer and are prepared to take another step towards a mutually beneficial agreement. 

We have verified the stable price history for the nuts and washers you cited; however, the overall kit cost is dictated by the components that have seen increases. 

Building on your Option C, we can offer a revised price of EUR 5.49 per unit for a 24-month contract with 30 days net payment terms. To be precise, our current offer stands at a price of €5.49 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, and a contract term of 24 months. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Stadler
Inside Sales, Schraubenhandel Leitner & Sohn GmbH

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Schraubenhandel Leitner & Sohn GmbH: Bundle the fastener kit with one distributor
messages.body:

Thank you for your revised offer and for the many years of trusted cooperation between our two family companies. We value it greatly.

One point we would like to put on the table openly:

We say this in the spirit of partnership, because we want a fair solution for both of us. Please see our options below. Option A answers your wish for a longer contract with the same term you proposed, and Option C keeps your preferred payment terms.

We can offer you the following options:
Option A: unit price EUR 5.24; payment 60 days net; contract term 24 months.
Option B: unit price EUR 5.09; payment 45 days net; contract term 24 months.
Option C: unit price EUR 5.21; payment 30 days net; contract term 24 months.

We hope one of these works for you and look forward to your reply.

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Schraubenhandel Leitner & Sohn GmbH: Bundle the fastener kit with one distributor
